sources.snippet: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model is part of Meta's advanced suite of multilingual large language models. This 8B Instruct model has been fine-tuned using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforced through reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF).
